topics.title: Stern Discusses Romantic Desires
topics.summary: Howard Stern expresses his frustration with a lack of sexual activity within his marriage and openly invites listeners to become his romantic partner, detailing specific desires for companionship and intimacy while acknowledging the unusual nature of his request.

topics.title: Sexual Misunderstandings & Model Shopping
topics.summary: Howard obsessively discusses his wife’s claims about their sexual history, focusing on finding a girlfriend named Malika Sorey (misspelled as ‘Sorey’) and expressing frustration over the misspelling. He considers dating options like Cindy Crawford while grappling with perceived lies regarding past encounters.

topics.title: Listener Offers Tape & Discusses Flight Costs
topics.summary: A listener calls in complaining about a friend’s $7,000 flight to Los Angeles and offers to mail out copies of the recording. The host explores entertainment options for the friend – including tickets to see Sam Kinneson at Westbury Music Fair–and discusses potential improvements to the studio recording process.

topics.title: Stern Discusses Wife's Jealousy & Crime
topics.summary: Howard Stern discusses his wife’s jealousy over his attention to Jessica Hunt’s breasts, detailing a prolonged ‘taunting’ game while recounting the details of an arrest involving a violent criminal. He then shares anecdotes about dating and criticizes Cousin Bruce Morrow for repeatedly screaming accusations during awards ceremonies.

topics.title: Bush Discusses Polish Aid and Central Park
topics.summary: Howard Bush discusses the ongoing debate surrounding U.S. aid to Poland with varying funding levels ($400 million vs $800 million). He then transitions into an unrelated commentary about a jogger in Central Park, questioning her motivations for running at night and speculating on her addiction issues, alongside discussions of court cases and Glamour magazine’s naming the jogger ‘Woman of the Year.’

topics.title: Vinny Sets Himself On Fire - Drug Talk & Robin's Weight
topics.summary: During a chaotic radio segment, Howard discusses comedian Vinny Mazzio Jr., who set himself ablaze for entertainment at Lisbon Manor and Uncle Floyd’s show. The conversation quickly shifts to drug use (marijuana), Robin’s weight loss journey, bizarre claims about aspirin being illegal, and an odd discussion involving a fictional ‘Nutri-Crisps’ diet.
